text: CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE SUMMARY (SCORE) INFORMATION
markdown: CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE SUMMARY (SCORE) INFORMATION

text: This document presents the information required by RA legislation regarding credit history and credit score summary (score), the factors affecting it, and their use in the lending process by Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter referred to as the "Bank").
markdown: This document presents the information required by RA legislation regarding credit history and credit score summary (score), the factors affecting it, and their use in the lending process by Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter referred to as the "Bank").

text: Credit history is the information created/processed by a credit bureau regarding a customer's financial obligations, reflecting the customer's debts, payments, payment habits, and the dynamics/history of this information.
markdown: Credit history is the information created/processed by a credit bureau regarding a customer's financial obligations, reflecting the customer's debts, payments, payment habits, and the dynamics/history of this information.

text: Credit history includes, in particular, the identification data of the customer, the amount of each obligation, annual interest rate, outstanding balance, payment frequency and due dates, delays in payments, guarantees provided for third parties, depersonalized information about obligations of related parties, as well as data on inquiries made about the credit history.
markdown: Credit history includes, in particular, the identification data of the customer, the amount of each obligation, annual interest rate, outstanding balance, payment frequency and due dates, delays in payments, guarantees provided for third parties, depersonalized information about obligations of related parties, as well as data on inquiries made about the credit history.

text: As a rule, credit history is used by financial institutions to assess a customer's ability to assume/maintain financial obligations, act as a guarantor, evaluate lending opportunities either at the initiative of the customer or the Bank, or provide loan offers to the customer.
markdown: As a rule, credit history is used by financial institutions to assess a customer's ability to assume/maintain financial obligations, act as a guarantor, evaluate lending opportunities either at the initiative of the customer or the Bank, or provide loan offers to the customer.

text: Based on the customer's consent, the Bank submits an inquiry to ACRA Credit Reporting. Credit history information is reflected in a credit report that contains the customer's credit history for the previous 5 years as of the date of inquiry.
markdown: Based on the customer's consent, the Bank submits an inquiry to ACRA Credit Reporting. Credit history information is reflected in a credit report that contains the customer's credit history for the previous 5 years as of the date of inquiry.

text: The customer can review their credit history at http://www.acra.am/.
markdown: The customer can review their credit history at [http://www.acra.am/](<http://www.acra.am/>).

text: The credit score is a numerical evaluation of the customer's creditworthiness and reliability.
markdown: The credit score is a numerical evaluation of the customer's creditworthiness and reliability.

text: The Bank uses its own creditworthiness and reliability evaluation system for lending purposes, with the main influencing factors listed below:
markdown: The Bank uses its own creditworthiness and reliability evaluation system for lending purposes, with the main influencing factors listed below:

text: Credit history: The number and amount of active loans, frequency of loan applications, and a positive credit history (no delays, high-quality servicing) can help improve the score and lead to loan approval. A poor credit history (delays, long-term delinquencies) may lower the score and result in rejection or stricter conditions.
markdown: Credit history: The number and amount of active loans, frequency of loan applications, and a positive credit history (no delays, high-quality servicing) can help improve the score and lead to loan approval. A poor credit history (delays, long-term delinquencies) may lower the score and result in rejection or stricter conditions.

text: Employment, income, and work experience: Having stable employment/income can increase the score and lead to approval. Unstable or irregular income/employment may lower the score and lead to rejection or stricter terms.
markdown: Employment, income, and work experience: Having stable employment/income can increase the score and lead to approval. Unstable or irregular income/employment may lower the score and lead to rejection or stricter terms.

text: Credit burden: A high debt-to-income ratio can negatively impact the score, while a low credit burden can help improve the score and lead to approval.
markdown: Credit burden: A high debt-to-income ratio can negatively impact the score, while a low credit burden can help improve the score and lead to approval.

text: FICO Score: A FICO score is a statistical scoring model based on credit history used globally to assess credit risk. Details at acra.am.
markdown: FICO Score: A FICO score is a statistical scoring model based on credit history used globally to assess credit risk. Details at [acra.am](<https://acra.am/%d5%bd%d6%84%d5%b8%d6%80/>).

text: The importance of credit history and score
markdown: The importance of credit history and score

text: Credit history and credit score play a critical role in the decision-making process for loan approval, allowing banks and credit organizations to assess the level of credit risk and predict the customer’s likelihood of proper repayment.
markdown: Credit history and credit score play a critical role in the decision-making process for loan approval, allowing banks and credit organizations to assess the level of credit risk and predict the customer’s likelihood of proper repayment.

text: If the credit history contains errors or incomplete data, the customer may apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or the financial organization that provided the incorrect data.
markdown: If the credit history contains errors or incomplete data, the customer may apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or the financial organization that provided the incorrect data.

text: For inquiries to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC, the procedure and detailed description are available at acra.am.
markdown: For inquiries to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC, the procedure and detailed description are available at [acra.am](<https://acra.am/%d5%af%d5%a1%d5%ba-%d6%87-%d5%a1%d5%bb%d5%a1%d5%af%d6%81%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%a9%d5%b5%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6/%d5%b0%d5%a1%d5%b3%d5%a1%d5%ad%d5%b8%d6%80%d5%a4%d5%ab-%d5%ab%d6%80%d5%a1%d5%be%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6%d6%84%d5%b6%d5%a5%d6%80/>).

text: Steps to improve credit history and credit score

text: To improve credit history and score, it is necessary to eliminate the root causes as soon as possible, particularly:

text: Make regular loan payments according to the schedule, avoiding even a single day’s delay
markdown: Make regular loan payments according to the schedule, avoiding even a single day’s delay

text: Reduce the number and amount of guarantees provided; if possible, ensure repayment of overdue guaranteed obligations

text: Ease the credit burden by paying off overdue obligations

text: Avoid frequent applications for new loans, as credit history inquiries (except those for loan monitoring) may negatively impact the score
